universe_definition: Every official iShares World Islamic holding with assetClass Equity and marketCurrencyCode EUR. This is a provider-screened developed-market EUR equity universe, not the entirety of EUR listed equities. Country is issuer countryOfRisk and can differ from exchange and ISIN prefix. No Yahoo mappings certified by provider.
